title: A Drop for the Cover
author: Astrid Vasquez
blurb: Gideon Reyes, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, works cases no one wants attributed. But when a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
